packages.name: AI Router
packages.description: LLM-orchestrated PCB routing for KiCad: deterministic TraceMaker passes, DRC gating, finishing and stitching. Local or Docker backend.
packages.description_full: AI Router finishes PCB layouts in KiCad 10 with deterministic tools under an exact-geometry gate. An LLM (or the built-in AUTO strategy, which needs no LLM) makes strategy decisions only - it never draws geometry. All copper is produced by deterministic code: TraceMaker routing passes, a grid-A* finisher with displacement and re-bridging, a plane-fragment healer and a pour stitcher. Every result is accepted or reverted by kicad-cli DRC plus exact clearance checks, with a per-layer track census and split-net metrics on every gate. Requires the TraceMaker routing engine (open source, GPL-3.0) and, for routing jobs, the routing backend whose Docker image is provided in the repository. The plugin always works on a copy of your board; the open board is never modified.
